summary: Iter 56 — Refactor Phase 2 regression (backend + frontend). Built /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_iter56.py with 26 pytest cases: (1) CalculationBody schema alignment — POST /api/calculations now accepts optional forticlad + gelismis_forticlad (defaults 0) and GET /api/unit-costs/{category} exposes both fields; (2) routes/announcements.py — list (+ filter=urgent), create with broadcast=false (no fanout side effects, no fanout key in response), patch → history snapshot → revert restores original body, delete, bulk-delete, editor-forbidden gate; (3) routes/guild_settings.py — GET default (60), PUT clamp 0..100 (250→100, -10→0), editor forbidden; (4) routes/point_calc.py extensions — GET /point-calc/export?kind=pre returns valid .xlsx (PK zip magic, >500 B), rejects unauth (401/403) and invalid kind (400), POST /point-calc/import round-trip of the just-exported bytes returns {updated, skipped, errors}, POST /point-calc/translate-all returns 200 or 503 (DeepL config-dependent) with {days_processed, strings_translated}; (5) Phase-1 regression sweep — commanders, alliance-colors, alliance-scopes, multiplier-history, unit-costs, legal, reports/guild-data.csv, point-calc list, health. Result: 26/26 PASS in 27s against the production external URL. Frontend: home page renders in Turkish, language switcher opens (data-testid attributes present), TR→EN→RU switching confirmed live (menu changed 'Türkçe' → 'English' → 'Русский' UI strings). No i18n compile errors after the 10,085 → 109-line loader rewrite; no page errors; only pre-existing hydration warning about nested <button> in Leaderboard row (unrelated to this refactor).

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: <button> nested inside another <button> (row-alliance inside leaderboard-row). Not introduced by this refactor but visible in console.

action_items: MINOR: routes/point_calc.py uses `Depends(require_admin or require_edit)` on translate-all and import. Python evaluates `func_a or func_b` at import time → always returns `require_admin` (functions are truthy). So the 'admin OR editor' intent is silently dropped — only admins pass. If editor access is required, wrap in a helper `require_admin_or_edit` dependency. If admin-only is intended, remove the confusing `or require_edit` for clarity.

MINOR: routes/announcements.py line ~197 uses `update['title'].lstrip('🚨 ')` — str.lstrip takes a *set of chars*, not a substring, so it will also strip stray leading spaces/emoji characters. Use `removeprefix('🚨 ')` (Py 3.9+) instead.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 10,822 lines — even after this iteration's ~475-line reduction plus the massive i18n win, the backend monolith remains the top structural risk. Prioritise extracting members/events/leaderboard/points-crud next.
`Depends(require_admin or require_edit)` in routes/point_calc.py (translate-all + import) is a latent bug pattern — evaluates to `Depends(require_admin)`. Fix or delete the misleading `or`.
`str.lstrip('🚨 ')` in routes/announcements.py PATCH handler removes any leading char from the set — not the substring. Use `str.removeprefix`.

i18n/index.js loader is clean and small — nice cleanup. Consider dynamic imports (`import(./langs/${code}.js)`) if bundle size becomes a concern; current eager-import bundles all 29 languages into the initial chunk.

routes/announcements.py cleanly uses callable DI for the 4 fan-out helpers and translate_fields — good pattern; recommend documenting the expected async signatures via typing.Protocol so a helper rename can't silently break wiring.

success_rate.frontend: smoke pass (home renders, i18n loader compiles, TR/EN/RU switching verified)
